posts.post:
we finally decided against labels.

every time we mock up a logo, it just feels like shouting for no reason.
nothing worse than buying a high-end shirt and the tag makes you itch for eight hours straight.

most guys act like the zipper is the most important part of a jacket.

it’s never the zipper.

waking up, putting on the same pants you wore yesterday, and not thinking twice about it.

that’s the sweet spot.
